purpose: Frozen no-network Bates paper-style reference for COS, FFT, FRFT and Lewis validation.
note_on_tolerance: MathWorks prices are from a different mu_j conversion. Our engine uses mu_j = log(1+mean_pct) - 0.5*sigma_j^2 = 0.01660262729617973. The MathWorks prices agree to ~0.7% (7e-3), not 5e-4. Use call_prices_our_convention for exact cross-engine tests.
